title: AudioEngineContract
description: Interface contract for the modular Web Audio, Recorder, STT, and TTS engines

startRecording.description: Method returning Promise<void>, requests microphone and initializes MediaRecorder

stopRecording.description: Method returning Promise<AudioRecordingResult> with blob, mimeType, and durationSeconds

onWaveformSample.description: Event subscription providing Float32Array or Uint8Array frequency/time-domain data

startListening.description: Initializes live speech-to-text recognition with lang='fr-FR'

stopListening.description: Stops speech recognition and finalizes transcription

speak.description: Method taking text (string) and options (voice, rate, pitch), returns Promise<void>
